data.translation: du wirst gleich gebären und uns bei den Leuten in Schande bringen

rationale: Thin Infectum cell, 2sg.f agent and 1pl affected suffix.

data.turoyo: Maḥtulle bi awda w i ǧeriye gaba. Məllala li ǧeriye, əmmo: “I naqla d oṯe abre du paša d gowər, ḥet i mandelo taḥtəx w ḥet nuqṭo d admo, sum i mandelo nuqṭe d admo, lo kəmtani, w lo kmahtakləx.”
data.translation: Als sie ihren Einzug gehalten hatte, brachte man sie nebst ihrer Sclavin in ein Zimmer; diese aber sprach zu ihrer Herrin: »Wenn nun der Prinz kommt, in sein eheliches Recht zu treten, so lege dein Tuch unter dich und sprenge auf das selbe einen Blutstropfen nach dem andern; so wird dein Mann nichts sagen und dich nicht in Schande bringen«.

rationale: Thin Infectum cell, 3sg.m agent and 2sg.f patient; childbirth/deception context retained.

data.turoyo: bale lə ṭorət d šəmʕi an noše, elo gmahətkatlan d šəmʕi an noše.
data.translation: aber lass die Leute nichts von der Sache merken, denn du bringst uns in Schande, wenn die Leute es hören.

rationale: Fifth Infectum example, explicit public-hearing condition.

summary: Clear Infectum tokens preserve III transitive shame/disgrace: a second-person feminine agent may index a first-person plural affected group, while a third-person masculine agent indexes a second-person feminine patient. No new sense is required.

mahətkono without ruḥi has implicit self-involvement beside the inherited explicit ruḥi example. This alone does not establish Detransitive morphology. The edition's 'would have' does not add -wa to the Turoyo.
Reciprocal mahtaklan ḥḏoḏe is already quoted and remains Preterit sense 1; 'insult one another' is covered by the entry's dishonour gloss.

mahatkina is the exact inherited Detransitive Preterit example, but its form and prospective function do not independently support that box. Do not create a Detransitive numbered gloss or new example until the paradigm is checked.
No new Idiomatic phrases. These are productive reputation, reflexive and reciprocal constructions; the borrowed verb itself is not a light-verb collocation.
PrS 28/12 mahatkina: active III Infectum 1pl with self/household affected, a local Detransitive form, or a transcription issue? Check the inherited htk.III.d.preterit.1 before moving it.
Check Prym–Socin concordance: supplied PrS 28/12 versus prs 68/30 and PrS 75/54 versus prs 219/20. Do not replace references by assuming identical numbering systems.
MAC NE Old woman and a fox/46: confirm implicit reflexive patient in mahətkono; no -wa morphology appears.
Public disgrace extends from individual exposure to household reputation. Reciprocal insult and explicit/implicit reflexive patients keep the broad existing dishonour meaning.
